description.purpose: Portable W3C PROV-O lineage for existing BCM source documents, immutable artifacts, exact anchors, evidence links, and explicitly recorded processing activities or agents.
description.usage: Public BCM and private regulatory providers exchange schema-valid JSON-LD plus this ODCS definition, then MUST validate the whole graph through `bcm-prov validate` / `provenance.ParseJSONLD` before admission. The canonical verifier alone decides legal status.
description.limitations: Metadata and deterministic lineage only; a well-formed graph does not establish authentic source bytes, independent review, legally effective adoption, address-level jurisdiction or a verified project. No private source text or bulk regulatory corpus may be published. JSON Schema cannot enforce cross-node references or uniqueness; a successful structural schema check must never substitute for the repository-owned closed-graph validator.

properties.name: @context
properties.description: Fixed W3C PROV-O, BCM extension and XML Schema namespace bindings

properties.name: @graph
properties.description: At least one graph node; source-only entities, genuinely observed activities and agents

properties.name: @graph[].@id
properties.description: Absolute, stable URI for each graph node

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:sourceID
properties.description: Preserved BCM source identity, never constructed from a URL alone

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:sha256
properties.description: 64-character exact immutable source or passage digest

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:claimKind
properties.description: Claim kind tied to the hash-bound version-qualified source identity

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:jurisdictionID
properties.description: Claim jurisdiction tied to hash-bound scope

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:asOf
properties.description: xsd:date claim applicability, scoped into immutable claim identity

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:legallyMaterial
properties.description: Explicit true or false, never inferred from evidence

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:targetsEvidenceLink
properties.description: Closed same-claim evidence supersession target; must be validated with the Go importer
